entities.name: Pedro Luiz Napoleão Chernoviz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Luiz Napoleão Chernoviz, was a physician, scientific writer and publisher. He was born in Łuków (Poland) and immigrated to Brazil in the mid 19th century on a mission on behalf of King Louis-Philippe of France to Emperor Dom Pedro II of Brazil.
